Prince Naseem Hamed.description: Prince Naseem Hamed is a British former professional boxer who competed from 1992 to 2002, holding multiple featherweight world championships including the WBO, IBF, and WBC titles between 1995 and 2000. Known for his flamboyant ring entrances, southpaw style, and an 84% knockout-to-win ratio, he was a dominant figure in 1990s British pop culture and a globally recognised sporting star. Inducted into the International Boxing Hall of Fame in 2015, he received The Ring magazine's honorary featherweight title in 2019. He likely crossed paths with Conan O'Brien on Late Night with Conan O'Brien around 2001, near the end of his professional career.

Rhea Perlman.description: Rhea Perlman is an American actress and author best known for her eleven-season run as wisecracking barmaid Carla Tortelli on the landmark sitcom Cheers, a role that earned her four Emmy Awards for Outstanding Supporting Actress and a record six Golden Globe nominations in that category. Her film credits include Matilda, Canadian Bacon, The Sessions, and Poms, and she earned considerable critical praise playing Barbie creator Ruth Handler in Greta Gerwig's Barbie (2023). More recently, she appeared in the second season of the crime mystery series Poker Face. Perlman also writes illustrated children's books under the Otto Undercover series. She likely crossed paths with Conan O'Brien during his tenure on Late Night with Conan O'Brien, with a first appearance dating to around 2001.

The Minus Five.description:
The Minus 5 is an American pop rock band headed by musician Scott McCaughey of Young Fresh Fellows, often in partnership with R.E.M. guitarist Peter Buck. == Band history ==
McCaughey formed the band in 1993 as a side project with Buck, Jon Auer and Ken Stringfellow of the Posies. Buck had moved to the Seattle area in 1992; the other principals were longtime fixtures of the Seattle music scene. First appeared on Late Night with Conan O'Brien in 2001.
